responsibility: This module provides the gm2-ici support layer used by GNU Modula-2 tooling for source-location handling and user-facing diagnostic emission outside the full cc1gm2 front-end environment. Its core files implement formatted errors, warnings, notes, and internal-error reporting from Modula-2 lexer/token positions, including file:line:column presentation and related output conventions, while also defining the boundary to GCC’s normal linemap infrastructure through a minimal stub location-mapping implementation for standalone builds. In practice, gcc/m2/gm2-ici is the lightweight integration and diagnostics interface that lets gm2 tools report source positions and messages consistently without depending on the complete compiler-side location machinery.
